what_they_do_well: Marsh Mills, Plymouth branch has traded since 1994 according to the Sainsbury Archive.
sainsburys.co.uk.distributes: Full-range grocery including confectionery, biscuits, free-from and health food.
sainsburys.co.uk.channels_supplied: Own superstores and convenience stores plus online delivery; Plymouth Marsh Mills superstore and Armada Centre store.
sainsburys.co.uk.sf_brands_carried: Free-from range nationally; Plymouth-specific sugar-free brands not verified.

savageandwhitten.com.name: S&W Wholesale (Savage & Whitten)
savageandwhitten.com.fit_rationale: An all-island delivered wholesaler with a dedicated Republic of Ireland line. Whether its routes reach Dublin retailers was not confirmed, so qualify this first.
savageandwhitten.com.distributes: Full grocery and convenience wholesale range (categories not detailed in sources).
savageandwhitten.com.channels_supplied: Over 2,500 retail customers in Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, with next-day delivery to many parts of the island.

saviva.ch.name: Saviva AG
saviva.ch.fit_rationale: A national catering delivery wholesaler, sold by Migros to Heba Food Holding in 2020, serving Zurich canteens and restaurants. Fit is mainly for portion packs and snacks for staff restaurants. Head office city is from prior knowledge and should be verified.
what_they_do_well: Absorbed Scana and Lüchinger + Schmid, reaching CHF 761 million net sales in 2015 under Migros.
saviva.ch.distributes: Foodservice delivery wholesale: food, beverages and catering supplies.
saviva.ch.channels_supplied: Gastronomy, canteens and community catering; online ordering platform.

selectvending.co.uk.name: Select Vending
selectvending.co.uk.fit_rationale: A Plymouth vending business with a wholesale company registered; impulse dispensers could carry sugar free bars, but it is more an operator than a wholesaler, so it is conditional.
selectvending.co.uk.distributes: Coffee machines, impulse snack dispensers, water dispensers and refreshment supplies.
selectvending.co.uk.channels_supplied: Workplaces and businesses in the Plymouth area.

selezione-sartorio.ch.name: Selsaco Selezione Sartorio
selezione-sartorio.ch.fit_rationale: A Zurich canton importer selling Italian specialities to retail and foodservice. Diablo's Italian made style biscuits and spreads could join a gourmet range. Confectionery depth not verified.

shelton.ie.name: Shelton Distributors
shelton.ie.fit_rationale: Family-run confectionery specialist in Co. Dublin that already imports European brands (Trolli, PEZ, Zaini, Look-O-Look, Hamlet) with its own fleet. It has a healthier-options gap that a full sugar-free range would fill and all-island coverage since a 2024 acquisition.
shelton.ie.distributes: Specialist confectionery and snacking distributor with 40+ brands: sugar confectionery, chocolate, toffee, protein bars, novelties.
shelton.ie.channels_supplied: Symbol groups, convenience, forecourts, independents, foodservice and leisure; its site names Gala, Barry Group, BWG, Musgrave, Carrolls, Lidl, Woodie's, Aramark and Compass. Over 2,000 customers.
shelton.ie.sf_brands_carried: Sante healthier options and Go On protein bars, Hamlet and Belfine chocolate, plus a 'Free From' store section. No dedicated sugar-free chocolate brand seen.

shs-sales.ie.name: SHS Sales & Marketing
shs-sales.ie.fit_rationale: One of Ireland's largest sales and marketing companies with order-to-cash, merchandising and distribution from Co. Dublin. Strong in biscuits and confectionery with no sugar-free line, but it favours large established brands.
shs-sales.ie.distributes: Agency sales, marketing and in-market distribution for 50+ grocery, confectionery, drinks and healthcare brands.
shs-sales.ie.channels_supplied: All-island coverage of multiples, convenience and wholesale.
shs-sales.ie.sf_brands_carried: Meridian nut butters and Organix; confectionery includes Terry's, Tunnock's, Fox's Burton's and Nerds. No sugar-free confectionery brand.

sjbfoods.com.name: SJB Foods
sjbfoods.com.fit_rationale: East Devon foodservice wholesaler. Low fit and uncertain Plymouth reach.
sjbfoods.com.distributes: Fresh, frozen and ambient food and drinks.
sjbfoods.com.channels_supplied: Pubs, restaurants, cafes and hospitality in Devon, Dorset and Somerset; Plymouth coverage unconfirmed.

springvalefoods.co.uk.name: Springvale Foods
springvalefoods.co.uk.fit_rationale: A national fine food and free from wholesaler that took over the Hider branded wholesale business, so it already moves imported confectionery into independents. Free from focus aligns with a sugar free proposition.
what_they_do_well: Acquired the Hider Foods branded wholesale business in 2021, absorbing its customers.
springvalefoods.co.uk.distributes: Speciality and fine foods, gluten free products, nuts, dried fruit and confectionery, over 3,000 lines.
springvalefoods.co.uk.channels_supplied: Delis, farm shops, garden centres and independent retailers nationwide, including former Hider Foods customers.
springvalefoods.co.uk.sf_brands_carried: Gluten free specialist; sugar free brands not verified.

staffordlynch.ie.name: Stafford Lynch
staffordlynch.ie.fit_rationale: Dublin 15 distributor that already sells Canderel into grocery, pharmacy and health stores, so the sugar-reduction buyer conversations exist. No confectionery in the portfolio, which means no conflict but also less category weight.
staffordlynch.ie.distributes: Food, non-food and medicinal agency brands with a 7,000 pallet logistics centre.
staffordlynch.ie.channels_supplied: Multiples, convenience, foodservice, pharmacy, discounters, health stores and online; about 3,000 retail touchpoints across the island.
staffordlynch.ie.sf_brands_carried: Canderel sweetener and LoSalt; no sugar-free confectionery brand.

stonehouse.ie.name: Stonehouse Marketing
stonehouse.ie.fit_rationale: A single central listing opens the independent wholesale tier, including Dublin members JR Byrne, Byrnes and Elliotts. It is the buying gateway rather than a stockholder, so pair the approach with the Dublin members.
stonehouse.ie.distributes: Central buying group for independent wholesalers: ambient grocery, confectionery, chilled and frozen, plus Homestead and White Hat own brands.
stonehouse.ie.channels_supplied: Member wholesalers and cash and carries nationwide (18 members listed on its site), plus retail partners Applegreen and Londis.

stutzer.ch.name: Stutzer & Co. AG
stutzer.ch.fit_rationale: A Zurich family importer with over 60 years in trade and ISO 22000 warehousing. Its range is broad and ingredient heavy, so Diablo would be a new branded line rather than a category fit. Useful as a local stockist for trade customers.
what_they_do_well: Family owned importer with over 60 years of trading, offering 4,000 products from one partner.
stutzer.ch.distributes: About 4,000 food, frozen, beverage, ingredient and non-food lines including Japanese, Korean, Thai and Italian ranges.
stutzer.ch.channels_supplied: Major distributors, retailers and the food industry.

suma.coop.name: Suma Wholefoods
suma.coop.fit_rationale: A national health food wholesaler that reaches Plymouth independents from its own fleet. Listing would give Diablo coverage of health stores across the whole South West in one step; vegetarian only policy suits Diablo.
what_they_do_well: Serves most of mainland UK from its own fleet of vehicles.
suma.coop.distributes: Vegetarian, vegan, organic and natural wholefoods, snacks and household goods.
suma.coop.channels_supplied: Mainly independent health food shops across mainland UK, served largely by its own vehicle fleet.

superdrug.com.name: Superdrug
superdrug.com.fit_rationale: Superdrug has a Drake Circus store and around 800 UK and Ireland stores under A.S. Watson. Its health positioning and till-point snacking suit small-format sugar-free sweets.
what_they_do_well: Part of A.S. Watson, with around 800 UK and Ireland stores including Drake Circus, Plymouth.
superdrug.com.distributes: Health and beauty, pharmacy and impulse snacks and confectionery.
superdrug.com.channels_supplied: Own stores including Drake Circus, Plymouth, plus online.

sweetco.ie.name: Sweet Co
sweetco.ie.fit_rationale: A confectionery specialist that already has a sugar-free category, showing demand. It is based in Donegal and sells largely online, so Dublin trade reach is by courier only.
sweetco.ie.distributes: Confectionery: pick and mix, bulk bags, retro sweets, chocolate bars, crisps and biscuits from brands such as Haribo, Swizzels and Sweetzone.
sweetco.ie.channels_supplied: Businesses buying in bulk, event organisers and consumers, with nationwide courier delivery.
sweetco.ie.sf_brands_carried: Lists a 'Sugarfree Sweets' category; brands not confirmed, so a competing line is possible.

syscoireland.com.name: Sysco Ireland
syscoireland.com.fit_rationale: The largest foodservice wholesaler serving Dublin. Fit is limited to portion or catering formats such as syrups and spreads for cafes and care homes. Head office location was not confirmed.
syscoireland.com.distributes: Foodservice wholesale: fresh, chilled, frozen and ambient food, catering supplies and drinks.
syscoireland.com.channels_supplied: Cafes, restaurants, hotels, pubs, care homes and some retail outlets across the island, with a distribution centre in north County Dublin.

tastemerchants.co.uk.name: Taste Merchants
tastemerchants.co.uk.fit_rationale: Already runs a sugar free category, proving demand from its small shop customers, but carries sugar free sweets that compete with Diablo's. Diablo's sugar free chocolate would fill a gap it does not cover.
what_they_do_well: Trading for 35 years with around 2,500 products.
tastemerchants.co.uk.distributes: About 2,500 grocery and confectionery lines including a dedicated sugar free category.
tastemerchants.co.uk.channels_supplied: Small businesses and shops across the UK with free delivery.
tastemerchants.co.uk.sf_brands_carried: Monmore and Simpkins sugar free sweets, Farmhouse sugar free biscuits, Tiptree reduced sugar jams.

tesco.com.name: Tesco
tesco.com.fit_rationale: Tesco has the largest grocery footprint in Plymouth, from the Roborough Extra to several Express stores. A central buying team and national free-from range make it the highest-volume route, although listings are decided nationally rather than locally.
what_they_do_well: Operates Plymouth Roborough Extra at Woolwell Crescent, with Express stores serving students on Mutley Plain.
tesco.com.distributes: Full-range grocery including confectionery, biscuits, free-from and health food aisles.
tesco.com.channels_supplied: Own superstores, Express convenience stores and online home delivery; Plymouth Roborough Extra plus Express stores on Mutley Plain and Discovery Heights.
tesco.com.sf_brands_carried: Free-from and sugar-free confectionery sections exist nationally; brands stocked in Plymouth not verified.

tesco.ie.name: Tesco Ireland
tesco.ie.fit_rationale: 177 stores and about 24% share, with a record of listing low-sugar and sugar-free confectionery lines. Diablo's UK entity may be able to use existing Tesco group supplier processes, though Irish ranging is decided locally.
tesco.ie.distributes: Full grocery including confectionery, biscuits, spreads, free-from and health snacks.
tesco.ie.channels_supplied: 177 stores across Ireland including Tesco Express convenience stores in Dublin, plus online grocery.
tesco.ie.sf_brands_carried: Stocks WONDR low-sugar protein jellies per 2026 trade press and listed Free'ist sugar-free jellies in 2018.

thehealthstore.ie.name: The Health Store
thehealthstore.ie.fit_rationale: Second Dublin health chain by store count, with 8 Dublin shopping centre stores trading since 1982. Health foods and sports nutrition ranges suit sugar-free chocolate and snacks; store count comes from a web agency case study so confirm it on first contact.
thehealthstore.ie.distributes: Vitamins and supplements, health foods, sports nutrition, natural body care; over 6,000 products.
thehealthstore.ie.channels_supplied: Own stores in shopping centres (11 reported: 8 Dublin, 1 Kildare, 2 Wicklow) including Henry Street and Liffey Valley, plus online.

therange.co.uk.name: The Range (CDS Superstores, including Wilko)
therange.co.uk.fit_rationale: Head office is in Derriford, Plymouth, and its Wilko brand reopened its first store in Plymouth. Food is a minor category, so confectionery listings are worth testing via Wilko first.
what_they_do_well: Founded in Plymouth in 1989 as a single store; head office moved to Derriford in 2019.
Bought the Wilko brand in 2023 and reopened Wilko stores from December 2023, starting in Plymouth and Exeter.
therange.co.uk.distributes: Homewares, garden, crafts, toiletries, pet and cleaning; Wilko stores also sell confectionery and snacks.
therange.co.uk.channels_supplied: The Range stores including the Derriford flagship, Wilko stores reopened from Plymouth, and Iceland frozen concessions in about 50 stores.

todays.co.uk.name: Today's Group
todays.co.uk.fit_rationale: Hancocks is a member, and a central deal could open several independent wholesalers serving the South West at once. South West membership beyond Hancocks is not verified.
what_they_do_well: Combined buying power of 5.7 billion pounds across 145 members (2017).
todays.co.uk.distributes: Buying group across grocery, impulse, licensed, foodservice and on-trade wholesale.
todays.co.uk.channels_supplied: About 145 independent wholesale members on 186 sites nationwide, plus the Today's retail club.

togafood.ch.name: Toga Food SA
togafood.ch.fit_rationale: Acts as the full Swiss import, sales and marketing arm for European brand manufacturers, which matches how an exporter like B Healthy would enter. It scouts new brands at ISM and Anuga, where Diablo exhibits its category. National delivery covers Zurich.
what_they_do_well: Holds IFS Logistic and IFS Broker certification with a 5,000 to 6,000 pallet warehouse handling about 5,500 tonnes a year.
togafood.ch.distributes: Branded European confectionery and snacks, spreads, gourmet products, pasta, oils and seasonings.
togafood.ch.channels_supplied: Swiss food retail trade, from very small customers (24 hour delivery from 15 cartons) to full truckloads; named chains not verified.

totalhealth.ie.name: totalhealth Pharmacy
totalhealth.ie.fit_rationale: Member-owned symbol group, so central listing is a recommendation and not a mandate. Its site links it with the Haven brand, which suggests the two groups are combining; confirm structure before approaching.
totalhealth.ie.distributes: Community pharmacy, health and beauty; online store.
totalhealth.ie.channels_supplied: Network of independent member pharmacies across Ireland with a support office in Santry, Dublin 9; count not verified.

trago.co.uk.name: Trago Mills
trago.co.uk.fit_rationale: Regional discount chain whose Liskeard and Newton Abbot stores draw Plymouth shoppers. It buys a wide variety of discounted stock, but confectionery range and buying route are unverified.
what_they_do_well: Grew from a small shed at Liskeard in the 1960s into four large stores.
trago.co.uk.distributes: Discount department stores selling homewares, DIY, garden, gifts and food lines.
trago.co.uk.channels_supplied: Stores at Liskeard (near Plymouth on the A38), Newton Abbot, Falmouth and Merthyr Tydfil.

transgourmet.ch.name: Transgourmet Schweiz AG (Prodega)
transgourmet.ch.fit_rationale: The largest Swiss foodservice and cash and carry wholesaler, owned by Coop, serves Zurich through Prodega markets and delivery. Listing would reach independent retailers, kiosks and caterers. It buys from importers as well as direct, so a listing usually needs a Swiss partner first.
what_they_do_well: Runs 31 Prodega cash and carry markets and 11 regional delivery warehouses with about 2,800 staff.
transgourmet.ch.distributes: Full range food and non-food wholesale, over 30,000 items.
transgourmet.ch.channels_supplied: Gastronomy, hotels, catering, retail and trade businesses via webshop delivery from 11 warehouses and 31 Prodega cash and carry markets.

uniphar.ie.name: Uniphar
uniphar.ie.fit_rationale: The pharmacy route for a diabetic-friendly range, with head office in Citywest and a stated push to build front-of-shop sales in independents. Confectionery is not a core category, so a pharmacy-specific range would be needed.
uniphar.ie.distributes: Full-line pharmacy wholesale of over 13,000 lines: medicines, vitamins and supplements and front-of-shop consumer products.
uniphar.ie.channels_supplied: About 2,000 pharmacies nationally, including McCauley, Hickey's, Allcare and Life pharmacies and a buying group of over 200 independents.
uniphar.ie.sf_brands_carried: Vitamins, minerals and supplements ranges; no sugar-free confectionery brand confirmed.

unitaswholesale.co.uk.name: Unitas Wholesale
unitaswholesale.co.uk.fit_rationale: A buying group, not a stockholder itself, but one central agreement reaches many independent wholesalers, and its Brand Box pilot gives new products access to 1,000 stores. Members in Devon and Cornwall are not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Runs Brand Box, an NPD pilot giving supplier partners access to 1,000 stores at launch.
unitaswholesale.co.uk.distributes: Buying group for foodservice and convenience wholesale across all grocery and impulse categories.
unitaswholesale.co.uk.channels_supplied: 172 independent member wholesalers that supply convenience stores and caterers, including in the South West.

united-drug.com.name: United Drug
united-drug.com.fit_rationale: The largest pharmacy wholesaler in Ireland, part of the PHOENIX group, and the second pharmacy route after Uniphar. Food and confectionery are not confirmed in its consumer range, so fit depends on a pharmacy-led pitch.
united-drug.com.distributes: Pharmaceutical wholesale plus a consumer division for over-the-counter medicines, cosmetics and fragrances.
united-drug.com.channels_supplied: Pharmacies, hospitals, nursing homes and GPs across Ireland with twice-daily delivery.

voigt.ch.name: Voigt AG
voigt.ch.fit_rationale: Family owned pharma wholesaler working with the Toppharm pharmacy group, which has outlets in Zurich. Smaller than Galexis, so a niche food line may get more attention. Head office city and domain are from prior knowledge and should be verified.
what_they_do_well: Supplies self dispensing doctors and works with the Toppharm pharmacy cooperation.
voigt.ch.channels_supplied: Self dispensing doctors and pharmacies, including the Toppharm cooperation.
voigt.ch.import_check: Apollo holds nobody with an email at this website

volg.ch.name: Volg Konsumwaren AG
volg.ch.fit_rationale: The fenaco wholesale arm supplying hundreds of Volg and TopShop convenience outlets, many in the canton of Zurich. Forecourt and convenience shoppers suit single sugar free bars and sweets. Usually lists via central buying, so pitch as a category add.
what_they_do_well: TopShop filling station shops grew sales 6.3% to CHF 244 million in 2015.
volg.ch.distributes: Grocery wholesale for convenience and village stores.
volg.ch.channels_supplied: Volg village stores, free retailers and TopShop filling station shops.

waitrose.com.name: Waitrose
waitrose.com.fit_rationale: Waitrose's Saltash store across the Tamar is the nearest to Plymouth and offers delivery into the city. Premium shoppers fit a European better-for-you brand, though there is only one local store.
what_they_do_well: Serves Plymouth from its Saltash store with home delivery and click-and-collect.
waitrose.com.distributes: Premium grocery, confectionery, free-from and health food.
waitrose.com.channels_supplied: Saltash store serving Plymouth, with delivery and click-and-collect.

webstar.ch.name: E. Weber & Cie AG
webstar.ch.fit_rationale: A Zurich based distributor with 201 to 500 staff and a broad range already covering health and sports foods. Size suggests solid Zurich trade reach. Directory only, so verify the business model.
webstar.ch.distributes: Broad food range including confectionery and snacks, dairy free, sports nutrition, organic and health food, frozen and ethnic food.
webstar.ch.channels_supplied: Distributor, wholesaler, retailer and online store.

well.co.uk.name: Well Pharmacy
well.co.uk.fit_rationale: Well has at least three Plymouth pharmacies serving patients including diabetics. Sugar-free sweets fit a small counter range, though pharmacy food ranges are limited.
what_they_do_well: Runs several Plymouth pharmacies including Old Laira Road, St Budeaux and Plympton.
well.co.uk.distributes: Community pharmacy, health products and a small range of snacks.
well.co.uk.channels_supplied: Own pharmacies in Plymouth including Old Laira Road, St Budeaux Wolseley Road and Plympton Ridgeway.

westcountry.co.uk.name: WestCountry Foodservice
westcountry.co.uk.fit_rationale: Leading regional foodservice distributor with depots in Cornwall and Newton Abbot. Fit is limited to cafes and care settings.
what_they_do_well: Works with over 100 local producers, including 30 farms.
westcountry.co.uk.distributes: Multi temperature foodservice products and local produce.
westcountry.co.uk.channels_supplied: Independent, care, education and hospitality customers across Devon and Cornwall, six days a week.

wholefoods.ie.name: Wholefoods Wholesale
wholefoods.ie.fit_rationale: Ireland's largest natural products wholesaler, based in Dublin 10 and part of the Total Produce (Dole) consumer health division. It reaches the health store and pharmacy channels where sugar-free confectionery sells best. Check whether the Lillys line overlaps with Diablo before pitching.
wholefoods.ie.distributes: Natural and health foods, snacks, chocolate, supplements, body care; over 8,000 lines.
wholefoods.ie.channels_supplied: Health stores, pharmacies and grocery; its site names Holland & Barrett, Boots, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores, Tesco and Centra; 2,500+ retail points.
wholefoods.ie.sf_brands_carried: Booja Booja, Deliciously Ella, Biona, Love Corn, Rude Health. Its site also lists 'Lillys', described as sugar-free confectionery; identity not verified.

wwfoods.ie.name: World Wide Foods
wwfoods.ie.fit_rationale: A third-generation ethnic food wholesaler with nationwide delivery and a snacks and confectionery offer. Diablo's halal-suitable lines could fit, though sugar-free is not a current focus.
wwfoods.ie.distributes: Halal and ethnic foods, over 5,000 items: snacks, desserts, confectionery, drinks, spices, rice, frozen and canned goods.
wwfoods.ie.channels_supplied: Retailers, marts, restaurants and foodservice across Ireland, delivered by its own fleet from Rathcoole.

xlentfoods.com.name: Xlent Foods
xlentfoods.com.fit_rationale: The main Plymouth based food wholesaler, with over 20 years serving the city. Best for cafe and school snacking routes rather than shelf retail.
what_they_do_well: Plymouth based customer service team serving Devon and Cornwall for over 20 years.
xlentfoods.com.distributes: Frozen, chilled and ambient food plus confectionery and snacks, packaging and disposables.
xlentfoods.com.channels_supplied: Cafes, schools, caterers, restaurants, hotels, care homes and retailers in Devon and Cornwall.

youings.com.name: Youings Wholesale
youings.com.fit_rationale: A Devon confectionery and tobacco wholesaler that serves independent shops. Plymouth coverage is uncertain so it sits behind local options.
youings.com.distributes: Tobacco, confectionery, crisps, snacks, groceries, soft drinks and alcohol.
youings.com.channels_supplied: Independent retailers; delivery coverage of Plymouth not confirmed.
